mistake: Correct conclusion with invented file-I/O mechanism and contradiction of the changed-file premise
root_cause: Model inferred behavior from the word verify instead of tracing the actual data dependencies
correction: cmd_verify does not read current evidence-file bytes. It calls entry_hash(e), which serializes the stored entry except its hash field. Stored evidence metadata is part of that entry, but referenced files are not reopened. A changed external file can therefore coexist with a matching entry hash. Preserve the premise that the external file changed. load_chain skips invalid JSON lines before verification.
